prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Pet Creation Path", "Select standard adoption for instant preset companions or custom photo upload for tailored pets."]
1: ["Log in with your existing account to keep your saved pets."]
2: ["Upload Photo & Select Art Style", "Ensure clear lighting and single subject photos for best custom pet generation results."]
3: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Review these essential controls to interact with, position, or hide your pet anytime.", "Press Alt+P to show/hide pet on screen"]
4: ["Already created a pet? Sign in with your original account method to restore your companion."]
5: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Give your new pet a name. You can edit names, outfits, and traits anytime later in desktop settings.", "Click confirm to finish registering your desktop companion."]
6: ["Rendering Desktop Pet Model", "Make sure desktop window transparency permissions are granted. Your pet will drop onto your screen shortly."]
7: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Discover how a virtual companion lives on your desktop screen while you work and play."]
8: ["Select Your First Desktop Companion", "Includes Free Starter Accessory Pack"]
9: []
